intro.en: Your logo, 1C, as the loading screen: it arrives, then opens onto the site (your Aoraki photograph stands in for the home page). Click anywhere or press R to play it again. On a page, , and . move to the previous or next version, 1 to 5 scores it, N opens your notes, M marks a spot, B comes back here.
intro.zh: 你選的標誌 1C 當載入畫面：它出現，接著打開進到網站（用你的 Aoraki 照片代表首頁）。點畫面任何地方或按 R 再看一次。在頁面上，逗號和句號鍵（, .）換上一版或下一版，1 到 5 打分數，N 打開筆記，M 標記一個地方，B 回到這裡。

desc.en: As on the font pages: the letters rise one by one, the line draws across, PHOTOGRAPHY fades in. Then the paper fades to the photograph.
desc.zh: 跟選字體時一樣：字母一個一個浮上來，線畫過去，PHOTOGRAPHY 淡入。接著紙淡掉，露出照片。

desc.en: The line opens from the middle; TUAN rises out of it and PHOTOGRAPHY drops out of it. Leaving, both sink back into the line and it closes.
desc.zh: 線從中間打開，TUAN 從線往上長出來，PHOTOGRAPHY 從線往下出來。離開時兩個都縮回線裡，線再收起來。

desc.en: The logo comes up slowly, like a print in the developing tray; then the photograph develops in from pale grey to full colour.
desc.zh: 標誌像暗房裡的相紙一樣慢慢顯出來；接著照片從淡淡的灰慢慢顯影成彩色。

desc.en: The letters drift in from far apart to their places, then the line draws out from the middle.
desc.zh: 字母從很開的地方慢慢靠攏到位置，線再從中間往兩邊畫開。

desc.en: It arrives letter by letter, a little quicker; then the paper parts along the line, TUAN going up and PHOTOGRAPHY down, and the photograph is there between them.
desc.zh: 字母一個一個出來，稍微快一點；接著紙沿著那條線分開，TUAN 往上、PHOTOGRAPHY 往下，照片就在中間出現。

desc.en: TUAN and PHOTOGRAPHY are there at once; the line fills from left to right as the photograph really loads, then it opens.
desc.zh: TUAN 和 PHOTOGRAPHY 一起出現；線從左到右填滿，就是照片真的在載入，滿了才打開。
